title: 'Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e.' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Ending Theme, First Promo, 2027 Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tsumuji Yoshimura 's Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e. ( Just Like Mona Lisa ) manga unveiled additional cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), the ending theme, and first promotional video on Wednesday. The anime series will premiere in 2027.

Cast Yoshino Aoyama ( Bocchi the Rock! ) Nobuhiko Okamoto ( Sousou no Frieren ) Daisuke Sakuma ( Kill Ao ) Chiharu ( 22/7 ) Kakeru Hatano ( Tamon-kun Ima Docchi!? ) Haruna Mikawa ( Ore dake Level Up na Ken ) Shion Wakayama ( Dandadan )

Staff Assistant Director: Kouji Matsumura ( Megami no Café Terrace episode director) Series Composition, Script: Katsuhiko Takayama ( Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha, Isekai Kizoku ni Tensei suru ) Chief Animation Director: Kazuya Shiotsuki ( Ninja to Koroshiya no Futarigurashi ), Akihisa Takano ( Nisekoi: ) Main Animator: Yoshiaki Itou ( Magia Record: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica Gaiden ) Art Board: Junichi Taniguchi ( Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon R art director) Art Design: Morihito Oohara ( Koukaku Kidoutai (TV)) Art Director: Yukako Ogawa (KLAS) ( Sword Art Online: Alicization ) Color Design: Yasuko Watanabe ( Owarimonogatari ) CG Director: Sasaki Kentarou (Buemon) ( Uchi no Maid ga Uzasugiru! ), Shima Hisato ( Assault Lily: Bouquet ) Director of Photography: Rei Egami ( Uchiage Hanabi, Shita kara Miru ka? Yoko kara Miru ka? ) Editing: Rie Matsubara ( Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai ) Sound Director: Kouhei Yoshida ( Koori no Jouheki )

Singer-songwriter imase ( Super no Ura de Yani Suu Futari ) is performing the ending theme "Mayoi wa Hikari," which previewed in the first promotional video below.

Kana Shundou ( Apocalypse Hotel ) is directing the anime at Shaft . Nobuhiro Sugiyama ( 3-gatsu no Lion ) is designing the characters and serving as chief animation director. Yuuki Hayashi ( Medalist ) is composing the music. CyberAgent is credited as executive producer.

Yoshimura began drawing the drama romance manga on the Gangan Online web magazine in May 2018. Square Enix published the tenth and final volume in December 2022.

Comikey and Square Enix licensed the manga in English in September 2023. Square Enix released the last two volumes on May 19.

PV 1

title: ghost – end of night Anime Film Unveils 3 Cast Members
content:
The official website for ghost – end of night ( ghost/yoru no hate ), Shingo Natsume and Madhouse 's new theatrical anime project, announced more cast members for the film on Wednesday. The newly announced cast members are:

Kenjirō Tsuda as Moby Dick, a man who takes an interest in Neekei

Hiroki Yasumoto as Karate, Masu's childhood friend, and a section manager at the observatory that Neekei works at

Hiroshi Kamiya as Itō, Masu's childhood friend, and the observatory's mental coach

The main cast members include:

Mayu Hotta as Neekei

Issei Takahashi as Masu ( Character name romanization not official )

Bandai Namco Filmworks describes the film's story:

I want to know what is ＜real＞. Set in the near future where labor is no longer necessary, this is the story of Neekei, a girl who continues seeking the “real” while resisting the order of a content society.

Shingo Natsume ( ACCA: 13-Territory Inspection Dept. , One-Punch Man , Sonny Boy , Space Dandy ) is both directing the anime at Madhouse and penning the script. Manga creator Natsume Ono ( ACCA 13-Territory Inspection Department , Ristorante Paradiso , House of Five Leaves , Not Simple ) is in charge of the original character designs. Norifumi Kugai ( ACCA: 13-Territory Inspection Dept. , Sonny Boy ) is designing the characters for animation. Bandai Namco Filmworks is distributing the film. Alternative rock band hitsujibungaku will perform the film's theme song, and will also perform the film's insert song "Sugar."

The film will open in Japan on February 11, 2027. GKIDS , Annecy International Animation Film Festival, and Variety's Animation is Film festival, which took place on October 16-19, screened the film.

The work marks Shingo Natsume 's first time directing an original anime film. Natsume said that he is aiming for "a work that could be called fictional but is in tune with our current time and seeks realism."

The film has a manga adaptation by artist himiko, which launched in Kadokawa 's Young Ace magazine on August 4.
author: ANN

title: MURCIÉLAGO Anime Reveals New Visual, Trailer, Main Cast
content:
The previously announced MURCIÉLAGO anime revealed a new visual and trailer, along with three additional cast members on Wednesday. It is slated to premiere in January 2027 with HIDIVE exclusively simulcasting in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand.

The main voice cast consists of:

• Hitomi Ueda as Kuroko Koumori

• Minori Suzuki as Hinako Tozakura

• Sumire Uesaka as Chiyo Yanaoka

The anime is a joint production between Satelight and Staple Entertainment and is led by Takashi Naoya, the chief director, with Matsuo Asami serving as director. The previously announced staff includes:

• Original work: Kana Yoshimura

• Chief Director: Takashi Naoya

• Director: Matsuo Asami

• Series Composition: Takashi Naoya

• Character Design: Sei Tateishi

• Music: Masanori Akita, Yuichi Tsuchiya

• Animation Production: Satelight × Staple Entertainment

MURCIÉLAGO has been serialized by Square Enix since August 2013, and the manga has surpassed 2.3 million copies in circulation worldwide and currently has 29 volumes in Japan and 27 internationally. Yen Press is publishing the manga in English, describing it as follows: Mass murderers may not have much by way of careeer skills, but Kuroko Koumori seems to have landed her dream job as a hitwoman for the Tokyo police! A license to kill other killers? That’s some serious job satisfaction, right there! Source: MURCIÉLAGO anime Official Website ©Yoshimurakana/SQUARE ENIX,MURCIÉLAGO Project

title: 3 Spooky Anime You Should Watch on Hulu This October
content:
With October nearing its end, it is the perfect time to embrace spooky elements, and Hulu , an emerging anime streaming platform, offers a variety of options to amplify the spookiness. With an abundance of series and streaming platforms to choose from, selecting what to watch has become increasingly difficult. Although Hulu is not a major anime streaming platform, it has its strengths in the industry.

If you have a Hulu subscription this month, the best way to make use of it is to explore the spooky anime in its vast library and embrace the Halloween spirit. In particular, these three anime are perfect for capturing the Halloween vibe on Hulu this October.

3) Uzumaki

Junji Ito is one of the most legendary manga artists, known for his unique approach to horror, blending cosmic elements with ideas that few others would ever consider. His latest anime adaptation of the enigmatic series Uzumaki is one of the best ways to understand what makes Junji Ito so different. The anime’s premise will take fans by surprise, as it features a town that becomes increasingly obsessed with spirals.

This cosmic spiral horror will keep you guessing what happens next. Another element that makes Uzumaki stand out is its black-and-white presentation, staying true to Junji Ito’s original vision for the manga. That said, the animation did begin to waver and failed to live up to expectations . Still, this miniseries is visually stunning and horrific, perfectly capturing the spooky vibe of the month that you can watch on Hulu.

2) The Promised Neverland

The Promised Neverland is a special entry on this list because, while it is a horror anime, it also undoubtedly features one of the best narratives in the genre. This is all thanks to its intriguing premise, which follows orphaned children being raised to be eaten by the monsters that have taken over the world. The viewers are treated to gripping suspense, and as the children discover why they are being pampered at the orphanage, they embark on a terrifying journey to escape this hellhole.

The anime’s first season perfectly captures what the shonen manga has to offer. However, the second season introduces its own narrative , completely undermining what the manga intended to convey. This is why fans should watch the first season of The Promised Neverland on Hulu this month to experience its horror elements before picking up the manga to discover what the story was always meant to deliver.

1) Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead

The genre that always delivers the best spooky vibes is none other than zombies, and Hulu also has one of the best zombie anime ever made , Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead . The anime’s premise is as generic as a zombie apocalypse can get. However, what makes it stand out is how its narrative feels realistic while embracing a sense of freedom. It achieves this through a protagonist who is grateful for the zombie apocalypse because it finally helps him escape the job he was stuck in.

As the apocalypse unfolds, the main character, Akira, creates a list of 100 things he wants to do before becoming a zombie. Believing that he will eventually turn into one, he decides that the things he has always wanted to do are worth pursuing before it’s too late. The anime presents the perfect “what if” scenario that many people struggle to imagine. Adapted by Bug Films, the anime also captures this concept perfectly, with colorful animation that enhances the spooky elements of its zombie scenes. This makes the anime series both horrifying and hilarious, with a vibrant style that makes it a perfect Halloween watch on Hulu this October.

title: Writer Skyfarm, Artist Tentashi's Wildcard Alchemist Manga Ends
content:
Manga UP! Global publishes the manga in English digitally and describes the story:

When a toxic guild dumps their "worthless, junk-making" alchemist, they make the biggest mistake of their lives. Iluto, an alchemist, is abruptly kicked out of Dragnate—the very guild that recruited him. Forced to go solo, Iluto shifts gears and heads into the forest on a monster survey. But waiting for him there is Noir, the fluffy divine beast that bestowed him the “Random Alchemy” skill! Between a divine beast coveted by several nations, a friendly personality that warms even elves, supreme mana control, and the divine “Random Alchemy” skill, Iluto starts gaining worldwide recognition. As his ex-guild crumbles and scrambles to find a suitable replacement, Iluto is busy assembling his ultimate dream squad with a beautiful elf girl and a fluffy divine beast!

The manga launched on the Manga UP! service in April 2025. Skyfarm ( 8th Loop for the Win! , Fed Up With Being the Spoiled Queen's Genius Butler ) writes the story, Tentashi draws the manga, and Dr. Mine is credited for composition. Square Enix published the manga's first compiled book volume in September 2025, and will publish the fourth and final volume on November 6.

title: Hikaru Nakamura's Black Night Parade Manga Ends, Teases Major Announcement on December 18
content:
Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga in English digitally and in print. The company describes the story:

Hino Miharu will be spending this Christmas just like the last: alone and working a dead-end job. All he wants is good employment, but when he meets a Santa Claus dressed in clothes as black as coal, he has no idea he's encountered the real deal...sort of. The Santa Claus dressed in red makes Christmas happen for good children everywhere, but his darker counterpart handles the holiday for the bad kids. As a name on the naughty list, Miharu is dashed away to work for the shadowy Santa. The pay and benefits are great, and his co-worker is cute–but will this end up being the dream job he's wished for, or a nightmare of a Christmas?!

Nakamura launched the manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Young Jump in November 2016. Shueisha published the manga's first compiled book volume in December 2016, and will publish the 12th and final volume on December 17. The manga has also run in other venues, including Digital Margaret , Shonen Jump+ , Cinra.net, LINE Manga , pixiv Comic , Nico Nico Seiga , and more. The manga started serialization in Ultra Jump in 2019.

The manga inspired a live-action film adaptation that opened in Japan in December 2022.

Nakamura is also currently drawing the Saint Young Men manga series, which started in 2006. The story follows the everyday lives of Jesus Christ and Gautama Buddha, who are roommates living in an apartment in Tokyo. A two-volume original anime DVD project produced by A-1 Pictures shipped in 2012 and 2013, and the manga also inspired an animated film in 2013. The manga has since inspired a live-action adaptation .

Nakamura's previous work includes Arakawa Under the Bridge , which ran from December 2004 to July 2015. The manga series has spanned 14 volumes and inspired two television anime series, a live-action television series, and a live-action film. Vertical licensed the manga, and is releasing it in omnibus volumes.

Nakamura also illustrated NisiOisin 's Juni Taisen: Zodiac War novel. Viz Media released the novel in October 2017, and it inspired a television anime. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan, and Funimation streamed a dub . The book received a sequel in December 2017.

title: Naruto Finally Gets a New Hokage, and It’s the One Fans Always Wanted (But Not Like This)
content:
The Hokage has always been an important part of Naruto , and celebrating a new one might just be the biggest occasion of all. Now, the Naruto franchise’s sequel, Boruto , is heading toward another change in the Hokage’s position, and while it is set to feature a candidate who is highly suitable for the role, it is happening under the wrong circumstances. Naruto’s dream of becoming Hokage was fulfilled in Boruto , allowing fans to see him live his dream, albeit not in the way he had always imagined. However, by the end of the Boruto series, Kawaki trapped Naruto and Hinata in a safe space to protect them.

Since Naruto’s entrapment, Shikamaru has served as Hokage in his absence, as he was deemed the most suitable candidate and handled the responsibilities well. However, Boruto: Two Blue Vortex has made things difficult for him , as he has had to take Boruto’s side despite the protagonist being labelled a traitor. This is exactly what Shikamaru has been dealing with, as Kobu, the representative of the Fire Nation’s Daimyo, has been suspecting him. Now, Kobu has concrete evidence to remove Shikamaru from the Hokage’s position, and he already has a new contender in mind, someone fans have always wanted to see in the role, but who is set to be positioned as a pawn.

Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 38 Has a New Hokage Ready to Take Over

Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 38 sees a discussion between Kobu and the shinobi he appointed to keep an eye on Shikamaru. They discuss how, while they are sure Shikamaru is allied with Boruto, they still need concrete evidence, which is exactly what the latest chapter provides. The other shinobi reveals that he has a book Shikamaru used to pass the code to Mitsuki to release Boruto, giving them the perfect evidence. With this, Kobu says he can replace Shikamaru with a new Hokage, and that candidate is none other than Konohamaru Sarutobi, one of the original characters fans have always loved.

With his dream of becoming Hokage and the Boruto series proving that he has become a capable shinobi who is not only strong but also loved by the people, there couldn’t be a better fit. That said, Kobu’s reason for replacing Shikamaru with Konohamaru is not that he considers him suitable for the position, but that Konohamaru would be the perfect candidate to control a village like Konoha, which is filled with shinobi. Kobu and the other higher-ups believe that shinobi are unnecessary.

Their vision involves developing the world into something more modern, where shinobi are seen as relics of the past. Shikamaru and Koji’s observations support this suspicion, and with Konohamaru, Kobu seems poised to advance this vision. However, the threat of the Divine Trees is real, and once they realize this, the Hokage’s position will become even more important. The question is whether Konohamaru will be able to fulfill this role. For now, with Shikamaru under suspicion, Konohamaru does seem to be the right fit for the next Hokage in the Naruto franchise, at least until Naruto returns or the chaos subsides, as Konohamaru could play both sides to keep things under control.

Now, the Naruto franchise’s sequel, Boruto , is heading toward another change in the Hokage’s position, and while it is set to feature a candidate who is highly suitable for the role, it is happening under the wrong circumstances. Naruto’s dream of becoming Hokage was fulfilled in Boruto , allowing fans to see him live his dream, albeit not in the way he had always imagined. However, by the end of the Boruto series, Kawaki trapped Naruto and Hinata in a safe space to protect them.

Since Naruto’s entrapment, Shikamaru has served as Hokage in his absence, as he was deemed the most suitable candidate and handled the responsibilities well. However, Boruto: Two Blue Vortex has made things difficult for him , as he has had to take Boruto’s side despite the protagonist being labelled a traitor. This is exactly what Shikamaru has been dealing with, as Kobu, the representative of the Fire Nation’s Daimyo, has been suspecting him. Now, Kobu has concrete evidence to remove Shikamaru from the Hokage’s position, and he already has a new contender in mind, someone fans have always wanted to see in the role, but who is set to be positioned as a pawn.
Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 38 Has a New Hokage Ready to Take Over

Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 38 sees a discussion between Kobu and the shinobi he appointed to keep an eye on Shikamaru. They discuss how, while they are sure Shikamaru is allied with Boruto, they still need concrete evidence, which is exactly what the latest chapter provides. The other shinobi reveals that he has a book Shikamaru used to pass the code to Mitsuki to release Boruto, giving them the perfect evidence. With this, Kobu says he can replace Shikamaru with a new Hokage, and that candidate is none other than Konohamaru Sarutobi, one of the original characters fans have always loved.

With his dream of becoming Hokage and the Boruto series proving that he has become a capable shinobi who is not only strong but also loved by the people, there couldn’t be a better fit. That said, Kobu’s reason for replacing Shikamaru with Konohamaru is not that he considers him suitable for the position, but that Konohamaru would be the perfect candidate to control a village like Konoha, which is filled with shinobi. Kobu and the other higher-ups believe that shinobi are unnecessary.

Their vision involves developing the world into something more modern, where shinobi are seen as relics of the past. Shikamaru and Koji’s observations support this suspicion, and with Konohamaru, Kobu seems poised to advance this vision. However, the threat of the Divine Trees is real, and once they realize this, the Hokage’s position will become even more important. The question is whether Konohamaru will be able to fulfill this role. For now, with Shikamaru under suspicion, Konohamaru does seem to be the right fit for the next Hokage in the Naruto franchise, at least until Naruto returns or the chaos subsides, as Konohamaru could play both sides to keep things under control.

title: Shiten Akiyama's Horizon Manga Resumes
content:
Kodama Tales licensed the manga, and it will release the first volume in January 2027. The company describes the story:

Mieko Fujiwara is a burnt-out office worker nearing the end of her twenties. After observing a group of carefree teens and longing for the life she used to have, Mieko drunkenly puts on her old school uniform and heads to the park, hoping to recapture even just the tiniest bit of who she used to be. Once there, she has a chance encounter with an impossibly handsome young man that will change her life forever.

The manga debuted in Young King BULL in June 2025. Shōnengahōsha published the manga's first compiled book volume on February 16.

Akiyama had posted an unofficially translated English version of the manga online in February, but revealed on X/Twitter that the publisher had them delete it.

title: 40 Years Later, Starship Troopers Should Return To Anime
content:
A recently reported reboot of the Starship Troopers franchise brings the 1997 cult classic to mind for a lot of people, but it wasn’t the first attempt at bringing Robert Heinlein’s novel to life. Would you like to know more? Well, nearly a decade before Paul Verhoeven’s movie hit theaters, an anime version was released in six parts for home video.

This series looks and sounds kind of like the blockbuster film, but it actually attempts to follow the source material more accurately. It’s somewhat forgotten, because of the confusion surrounding Verhoeven’s film . However, it’s time that this old tale got a reboot to match with Neil Blomkamp’s relaunch.

Starship Troopers Anime Took A Different Route

There are some notable differences between the anime and the live-action versions. The biggest being that the entire tone of the film felt much more serious and less like it was mocking the heavily militaristic themes of the book. The characters such as Johnny Rico, Carmen(cita), Carl, etc. are much the same. The difference is that it doesn’t fully touch on the political tone of the book and live-action. It does when it relates to disobeying orders, as soldiers are physically hit or not shown honor for heroic action, if it came without following the chain of command.

It tried to be more of a straightforward humans versus aliens story that also featured a decent portion of mecha action. The Federation uses individual armored power suits to fight the alien infestation, instead of unarmored, ground troops, which was one of Verhoeven’s key choices. American audiences hopped on anime a few years after the series first dropped, so it’d be the perfect time to retell the story in its exact universe.

A Starship Troopers Reboot Would Latch Onto Trending Human vs. Bug Titles

With some Mobile Suit Gundam -type elements , a story with high stakes and the brand name of Starship Troopers is sure to get some traction. Also, the recent run that the game Helldivers 2 went on has people more familiar with the franchise than ever. One change from the book that should be made for a new anime is that the aliens change to the form that’s been so iconic from the live-action movie. The “bugs” or “arachnids” just gave an invasion feel that the squid-like monsters don’t. However, the grittiness and graphic violence are still very much a part of the anime’s universe. The squids prove just as ruthless, so that element should still be able to stay in, as opposed to the Starship Troopers Roughnecks children’s cartoon.

Also, those who are fans of Warhammer 40,000 and Starcraft universes would be able to jump onto an anime reboot too. The Tyranids and Zerg respectively are very similar to the bugs, and the universes are much like the Starship Troopers world. Those franchises have been waiting for a movie based on those games. Although the franchise isn’t an exact carbon copy of those other two, this anime would certainly interest them.

The series took a swing at CGI with Japanese American films Starship Troopers Invasion and Starship Troopers Traitor of Mars . The action scenes were impressive and continued in the same timeline as the 1997 film, however they brought the power armor back into the fold, so there is some connection to the anime. There have been five movies made in the Verhoeven universe, but just one from the anime. This would give the creators some more room come up with different concepts. Would a new Starship Troopers anime do well with the fans? What do you think? Let us know in the comments!
